title: Polydatin Attenuates Zearalenone-Induced Hepatic Oxidative Injury through Dual Inhibition of Xanthine Oxidase and Activation of Nrf2 Antioxidant Pathway.
authors: Cao, Yufei; Zhang, Yiqiang; Zhou, Boran; Zhang, Yingxue; Han, Xu; Luan, Xinyuan; Wang, Yu; Zhao, Hongjing
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究虎杖苷通过抑制黄嘌呤氧化酶和激活Nrf2通路减轻玉米赤霉烯酮肝损伤，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-酶互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Zearalenone (ZEN) is a mycotoxin that induces hepatic oxidative injury by promoting ROS accumulation and compromising antioxidant defenses. Transcriptomic profiling revealed xanthine oxidase (XOD) as a key mediator. Structure-based molecular docking identified polydatin (PD) from Polygonum cuspidatum as a potent XOD inhibitor with strong binding affinity. Biochemical assays confirmed PD's XOD inhibition. In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrated that PD significantly attenuated ZEN-induced oxidative stress, reduced ROS generation, and improved pathological markers of liver injury, with optimal efficacy at low concentrations. Molecular dynamics simulations revealed PD forms a stable complex with XOD. Concurrently, PD activated the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway, enhancing SOD and GSH-Px expression while reducing lipid peroxidation. These findings demonstrate that PD mitigates ZEN hepatotoxicity through dual mechanisms: direct XOD inhibition and enhancement of endogenous antioxidant capacity, supporting its therapeutic potential.
abstract_zh: 玉米赤霉烯酮 (ZEN) 是一种霉菌毒素，通过促进ROS积累和削弱抗氧化防御机制诱导肝脏氧化损伤。转录组分析揭示黄嘌呤氧化酶 (XOD) 是关键介导因子。基于结构的分子对接鉴定出虎杖中的虎杖苷 (PD) 为强效XOD抑制剂，具有强结合亲和力。生化实验证实了PD对XOD的抑制作用。体外和体内研究表明，PD显著减轻ZEN诱导的氧化应激，减少ROS生成，并改善肝损伤的病理标志物，在低浓度下效果最佳。分子动力学模拟显示PD与XOD形成稳定复合物。同时，PD激活Nrf2/HO-1通路，增强SOD和GSH-Px表达，同时减少脂质过氧化。这些发现表明，PD通过双重机制减轻ZEN肝毒性：直接抑制XOD和增强内源性抗氧化能力，支持其治疗潜力。
